4d2e221072f5.en: DeepSeek-V3 has six hundred and seventy-one billion parameters. <bookmark mark='a'/> But for each token it reads, it uses only 37 billion of them. Each of its expert layers holds 256 small networks, called experts, and a router sends each token to just 8 of them, plus one that everyone shares. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch: every word lights up a different few. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the models keep getting sparser. Kimi K3, released in July 2026, has 896 experts in a layer and uses 16 of them, plus 2 shared: 3.7 percent of its weights for each token.
4d2e221072f5.zh: DeepSeek-V3有6710亿个参数。<bookmark mark='a'/>可它每读一个词元，只用其中的370亿个。它的每个专家层里有256个小网络，叫作专家；路由器把每个词元只送到其中8个，外加一个人人共享的专家。<bookmark mark='b'/>看：每个词都点亮不同的几个。<bookmark mark='c'/>而模型还在变得更稀疏。2026年7月发布的Kimi K3，每层有896个专家，每个词元用其中16个，外加2个共享专家：每个词元只用到它3.7%的权重。

82e3e15b5cbe.en: How did we get here? Three threads, which this part follows. <bookmark mark='a'/> The first is experts. In 1991 Robert Jacobs, Michael Jordan, Steven Nowlan and Geoffrey Hinton proposed a gate that picks which of several networks should answer. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2017 Noam Shazeer and colleagues, with Hinton again, made it sparse: thousands of experts, only a few run per token, a hundred and thirty-seven billion parameters. <bookmark mark='c'/> Google scaled it with GShard and the Switch Transformer, to a trillion and a half parameters; Mixtral made it open in 2023, and DeepSeek-V3 made it the frontier's standard. <bookmark mark='d'/> The second thread is attention that reads only some of the past: fixed patterns from 2019, sliding windows, and in 2025 patterns the model learns to choose. <bookmark mark='e'/> The third is the oldest: removing weights. Yann LeCun's optimal brain damage in 1990, the lottery tickets of 2018, and the two-in-four pattern NVIDIA built into its chips in 2020.
82e3e15b5cbe.zh: 我们是怎么走到这一步的？有三条线索，这一部分会一条条讲。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一条是专家。1991年，罗伯特·雅各布斯、迈克尔·乔丹、史蒂文·诺兰和杰弗里·辛顿提出：用一个门控，来决定几个网络里该由哪一个作答。<bookmark mark='b'/>2017年，诺姆·沙泽尔和同事们，辛顿也在其中，让它变得稀疏：成千上万个专家，每个词元只运行几个，参数多达1370亿。<bookmark mark='c'/>谷歌用GShard和Switch Transformer把它做大，做到1.5万亿参数；2023年Mixtral把它开源，DeepSeek-V3又让它成了前沿的标准做法。<bookmark mark='d'/>第二条线索，是只读一部分过去内容的注意力：2019年起的固定模式，滑动窗口，以及2025年由模型自己学会挑选的模式。<bookmark mark='e'/>第三条最古老：去掉权重。1990年扬·勒丘恩的最优脑损伤，2018年的彩票假设，还有2020年英伟达做进芯片里的四选二模式。

02ad2adf1f68.en: This is Part 16 of AI, Built: using only some of a model at a time. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this part: the mixture of experts, from its 1991 origin to the router's gradient, trained here on our own characters; how to keep every expert busy, with Switch's loss derived and DeepSeek's loss-free bias; capacity, chips and counting; what experts learn, and mixture-of-depths; attention that reads only some of the past, trained on a recall task; and sparse weights and activations, from lottery tickets to the two-in-four pattern. Every experiment runs on this computer.
02ad2adf1f68.zh: 这是《人工智能，从零搭建》的第16部分：每次只用模型的一部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>本部分的内容：混合专家，从1991年的起源讲到路由器的梯度，并在我们自己的字符数据上训练；怎样让每个专家都有活干，推导Switch的损失，再讲DeepSeek不靠损失的偏置；容量、芯片和参数的计数；专家学到了什么，以及深度混合；只读一部分过去内容的注意力，在一个回忆任务上训练；最后是稀疏的权重和激活，从彩票假设讲到四选二模式。每个实验都在这台电脑上跑。

5d35f3019eaa.en: In 1991 the question was how to make several networks share one job, instead of training one network to do everything. <bookmark mark='a'/> Jacobs, Jordan, Nowlan and Hinton's answer is the mixture of experts. Several small networks, the experts, each make a guess, and a gate, one more matrix and a softmax, decides how much to trust each one for this input. The answer is the trusted mix. <bookmark mark='b'/> The gate's numbers are like part seven's mixture weights, except that they change with the input: for one input the gate leans on expert two, for another on expert four. <bookmark mark='c'/> Their test was telling apart vowel sounds spoken by many people.
5d35f3019eaa.zh: 1991年的问题是：怎样让几个网络分担同一份工作，而不是训练一个网络什么都做。<bookmark mark='a'/>雅各布斯、乔丹、诺兰和辛顿的答案，就是混合专家。几个小网络，也就是专家，各自给出一个猜测；一个门控，就是再加一个矩阵和一个softmax，决定对这个输入该多信任每一个专家。答案就是按信任程度混合起来的结果。<bookmark mark='b'/>门控给出的数，就像第7部分的混合权重，只不过它们随输入而变：对一个输入，门控倚重专家2；对另一个输入，倚重专家4。<bookmark mark='c'/>他们的测试，是分辨许多人说出的元音。

46b0d514967e.en: The new idea was in the loss. <bookmark mark='a'/> The obvious loss fits the blend: the squared error of the gated sum. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its gradient tells every expert to chase the blend's error, so each expert's lesson depends on all the others: they cooperate, and they all end up a little responsible for everything. <bookmark mark='c'/> Jacobs and his colleagues instead treated the experts as a mixture of Gaussians, part seven's mixture model, and minimized the negative log likelihood. <bookmark mark='d'/> Now each expert chases its own error, <bookmark mark='e'/> weighted by h, the posterior probability that it was the one responsible: how much the gate trusted it, times how well it already explains the answer. Part seven's EM called this the responsibility. An expert learns most from the cases it already wins. They compete, and they become specialists.
46b0d514967e.zh: 新意在损失函数里。<bookmark mark='a'/>最直接的损失是拟合混合结果：门控加权和的平方误差。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的梯度让每个专家都去追混合结果的误差，于是每个专家学什么，都取决于其他所有专家：它们在合作，结果每个专家对所有事情都负一点责任。<bookmark mark='c'/>雅各布斯和同事们换了个做法：把这些专家看成一个高斯混合，也就是第7部分的混合模型，去最小化负对数似然。<bookmark mark='d'/>这样一来，每个专家追的是自己的误差，<bookmark mark='e'/>再乘上h，也就是它恰好是负责者的后验概率：门控有多信任它，乘以它对答案已经解释得有多好。第7部分的EM管这个叫责任。一个专家，从它本来就赢的样本里学得最多。它们相互竞争，于是成了专才。

ce06801f1fae.en: Here's that difference, trained on this computer. A curve with three regimes, a rise, a plateau and a fall, and four experts that can each draw only a straight line, with a gate that looks at x. <bookmark mark='a'/> The same mixture, trained the two ways. Watch the gates below the curves. <bookmark mark='b'/> Competing, the gate ends up sure of itself: on average it gives 92 percent of its trust to one expert, against 44 percent when they cooperate, over three seeds each. <bookmark mark='v'/>With competition, 3 to 3 experts each own a stretch of the line, one per regime, and the blend fits about as well: each expert does one simple thing.
ce06801f1fae.zh: 这就是两者的区别，在这台电脑上训练出来。一条曲线有三段：上升、平台、下降；四个专家各自只能画一条直线，门控看着x来分配。<bookmark mark='a'/>同一个混合模型，用两种方式训练。注意曲线下方的门控。<bookmark mark='b'/>竞争的时候，门控最后很有把握：平均把92%的信任给了同一个专家；合作的时候只有44%，两种各跑了3个随机种子。<bookmark mark='v'/>竞争的时候，有3到3个专家各自占据曲线的一段，一段对应一种走势，混合结果拟合得差不多一样好：每个专家只做一件简单的事。

2d9a1c2db589.en: In those early mixtures, every expert ran on every input, and the gate only weighed them. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1994 Jordan and Jacobs stacked gates into hierarchies and trained them with EM. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2017 Noam Shazeer and colleagues at Google turned the mixture into a way to grow. Keep only the top k gate scores, and set the rest to minus infinity, so their gates are exactly zero and those experts need never run. <bookmark mark='c'/> Add a little noise to the scores, so the router keeps trying other experts. <bookmark mark='d'/> Then the number of experts can grow without the work per token growing: they put thousands of experts between the layers of an LSTM, a hundred and thirty-seven billion parameters, more than a thousand times the capacity of the models before. That's the sparse mixture of experts every model in this part uses.
2d9a1c2db589.zh: 在早期的混合模型里，每个专家对每个输入都要运行，门控只负责加权。<bookmark mark='a'/>1994年，乔丹和雅各布斯把门控叠成层级结构，用EM来训练。<bookmark mark='b'/>2017年，诺姆·沙泽尔和谷歌的同事们，把混合专家变成了一种扩大模型的办法。只保留门控分数最高的k个，其余的设为负无穷，这样它们的门控正好是0，那些专家根本不用运行。<bookmark mark='c'/>再给分数加一点噪声，让路由器不停地试试别的专家。<bookmark mark='d'/>这样，专家的数量可以一直增长，而每个词元的计算量不变：他们在LSTM的层与层之间放了成千上万个专家，参数达到1370亿，容量是以前模型的一千多倍。这一部分里的每个模型，用的都是这种稀疏的混合专家。

3016064798cd.en: Chapter two. Top-k gates, and the router's gradient.
3016064798cd.zh: 第2章。top-k门控，与路由器的梯度。

27af627dfb60.en: Here's one layer of a modern mixture of experts. The feed-forward network of each transformer block becomes several smaller ones, the experts. <bookmark mark='a'/> A router, just one matrix, gives the token a score against every expert. <bookmark mark='b'/> Only the top k scores count: here, two of eight. Those experts run; the others don't. <bookmark mark='c'/> Their outputs are added up, weighted by gates: a softmax over the chosen experts' scores alone, so the gates add to one. That's Mixtral's gate, and the one most models use.
27af627dfb60.zh: 这是现代混合专家模型的一层。每个Transformer块里的前馈网络，变成了几个更小的网络，也就是专家。<bookmark mark='a'/>路由器，只是一个矩阵，给这个词元对每个专家打一个分。<bookmark mark='b'/>只有分数最高的k个算数：这里是8个里挑2个。这些专家运行，其余的不运行。<bookmark mark='c'/>它们的输出按门控加权相加：门控是只在被选中专家的分数上做的softmax，所以加起来等于1。这是Mixtral的门控，也是大多数模型用的门控。

ef74785a60fc.en: What does the router learn from? Take the gradient of the loss with respect to a score s j. <bookmark mark='a'/> The output depends on the scores only through the gates, so by the chain rule it's a sum over the chosen experts of u i, how much expert i's output pushes the loss, times the gate's derivative. <bookmark mark='b'/> The gates are a softmax, whose Jacobian is part four's g i times delta i j minus g j. <bookmark mark='c'/> Collect the terms: the gradient is g j times u j minus u bar, the gate-weighted average of the chosen experts. A chosen expert that helped more than the average gets its score raised; one that helped less gets it lowered. <bookmark mark='d'/> And an expert that wasn't chosen has no gate, so its score gets no gradient at all. <bookmark mark='e'/> The router only learns about the experts it tried. It never finds out whether an unchosen expert would have done better.
ef74785a60fc.zh: 路由器从哪里学？对某个分数s j求损失的梯度。<bookmark mark='a'/>输出只通过门控依赖分数，所以按链式法则，它是对被选中的专家求和：u i，也就是专家i的输出把损失推高多少，乘以门控的导数。<bookmark mark='b'/>门控是一个softmax，它的雅可比矩阵就是第4部分的g i乘以括号里δ i j减g j。<bookmark mark='c'/>把各项合起来：梯度等于g j乘以u j减u bar，u bar是被选中专家按门控加权的平均。一个被选中的专家，帮得比平均多，它的分数就被调高；帮得少，就被调低。<bookmark mark='d'/>而没被选中的专家没有门控，它的分数完全得不到梯度。<bookmark mark='e'/>路由器只能了解它试过的专家。一个没被选中的专家会不会做得更好，它永远不会知道。

be9141b405b8.en: Let's check it. One token, eight experts that are random linear maps, the top two chosen, and a squared error. <bookmark mark='a'/> Nudge each score up and down by a millionth and watch the loss: that's the gradient by finite differences. <bookmark mark='b'/> The formula gives the same bars, and so does automatic differentiation: they agree to 9 decimal places, relative to the largest bar. <bookmark mark='c'/> 6 of the 8 bars are exactly zero: only the chosen experts' scores move. We ran the same check on the router of the mixture layer we'll train in the next chapter, every one of its weights: they agree to 8 decimal places.
be9141b405b8.zh: 来验证一下。一个词元，8个专家，都是随机的线性映射，选中前2个，用平方误差。<bookmark mark='a'/>把每个分数上下各挪动百万分之一，看损失怎么变：这就是有限差分求出的梯度。<bookmark mark='b'/>公式给出的柱子一样，自动微分也一样：相对于最大的柱子，它们在小数点后9位都一致。<bookmark mark='c'/>8根柱子里有6根正好是0：只有被选中专家的分数会动。我们在下一章要训练的混合专家层的路由器上做了同样的检验，它的每一个权重：小数点后8位都一致。

4fc673da3483.en: Pause and predict. With one expert per token, and its gate renormalized to one, what does the router learn? <bookmark mark='a'/> Here are the four gates side by side. With two experts, mixed by a softmax or by DeepSeek's sigmoids, the two chosen scores learn. <bookmark mark='b'/> Switch's single expert is multiplied by its full softmax probability, so every score learns, through the softmax's denominator. <bookmark mark='c'/> But renormalize a single expert's gate and it's always exactly one: the router learns nothing, ever. That's why Switch keeps the raw probability. <bookmark mark='d'/> Either way, a router learns only from what it tried, which is why it needs noise to explore, and, as the next chapters show, help to share the work.
4fc673da3483.zh: 停下来预测一下。每个词元只用一个专家，而且门控重新归一化成1，路由器能学到什么？<bookmark mark='a'/>这是四种门控的并排比较。两个专家，用softmax或DeepSeek的sigmoid来混合，被选中的两个分数会学习。<bookmark mark='b'/>Switch的单个专家乘的是完整softmax的概率，所以通过softmax的分母，每个分数都会学习。<bookmark mark='c'/>但如果把单个专家的门控重新归一化，它就永远正好是1：路由器什么也学不到，永远学不到。这就是Switch保留原始概率的原因。<bookmark mark='d'/>不管哪种，路由器都只能从它试过的东西里学习；所以它需要噪声来探索，而且，后面几章会讲到，还需要帮助来分担工作。

92ce6bb1b456.zh: 第3章。训练一个混合专家模型。

204c5ce55e61.en: Now we build one. Part 13's transformer, shrunk to fit a laptop: two blocks, sixty-four numbers wide, reading sixty-four characters of the thirty novels. <bookmark mark='a'/> In the first model, each block's feed-forward layer is dense, two hundred and fifty-six wide. <bookmark mark='b'/> In the mixture it becomes eight experts, each half as wide, and a router picks two for each character: the same arithmetic per character, about 111 thousand parameters used, but 318 thousand in all. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the third is a dense model with all those parameters, one feed-forward layer four times as wide, which does three times the arithmetic. Each is trained three times, from three seeds, on exactly the same characters.
204c5ce55e61.zh: 现在我们自己造一个。第13部分的Transformer，缩小到笔记本电脑跑得动：2个块，64个数宽，读三十部小说里的64个字符。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一个模型里，每个块的前馈层是稠密的，宽256。<bookmark mark='b'/>在混合专家模型里，它变成8个专家，每个宽度减半，路由器为每个字符挑2个：每个字符的计算量一样，用到大约111千个参数，可总共有318千个。<bookmark mark='c'/>第三个是拥有全部这些参数的稠密模型，前馈层宽4倍，计算量是3倍。每个模型都从3个随机种子各训练一次，用的是完全相同的字符。

b77bace9aca9.en: Here are all nine runs. Held-out bits per character at eight points in training; each line is the mean of three seeds, and the band runs from the best seed to the worst. <bookmark mark='a'/> The mixture pulls ahead of the dense model with the same arithmetic by step 200 and stays ahead, in every seed: 2.146 bits a character at the end, against 2.246. <bookmark mark='b'/> And the dense model with all the parameters, doing three times the arithmetic, ends at 2.164: no better than the mixture, after the same short training.
b77bace9aca9.zh: 这是全部9次训练。在训练的8个时刻测留出数据上的每字符比特数；每条线是3个种子的平均，阴影带从最好的种子到最差的种子。<bookmark mark='a'/>到第200步，混合专家模型超过了计算量相同的稠密模型，而且一直领先，每个种子都是这样：最后每字符2.146比特，对比2.246。<bookmark mark='b'/>而拥有全部参数、计算量是3倍的稠密模型，最后是2.164：在同样短的训练之后，并不比混合专家模型更好。

5082d2b1d255.en: And here is the mixture's routing as it trains, replayed: for each common character, which experts its tokens are sent to, in both blocks. <bookmark mark='a'/> At first the router is random and nearly uniform: on average a character's favourite expert gets 49 percent of its tokens. <bookmark mark='b'/> Within 100 steps the router has committed: 48 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> And it stays that decided, 46 percent by the end. <bookmark mark='q'/>What the experts end up doing is chapter ten's question.
5082d2b1d255.zh: 这是混合专家模型训练时的路由，回放出来：每个常见字符的词元，被送到了哪些专家，两个块都有。<bookmark mark='a'/>一开始路由器是随机的，几乎均匀：平均来说，一个字符最常去的专家只拿到它49%的词元。<bookmark mark='b'/>不到100步，路由器就拿定了主意：48%。<bookmark mark='c'/>之后它一直这么果断，到最后是46%。<bookmark mark='q'/>专家们最后各自做什么，是第10章的问题。

a1dd1eb444d0.en: One caution before we celebrate. <bookmark mark='a'/> The mixture does the same arithmetic as the small dense model, but on this computer a training step takes 1.9 times as long as the dense model's. <bookmark mark='h'/>Sorting tokens by expert, gathering them, and scattering the answers back costs time that the arithmetic count doesn't see. <bookmark mark='b'/> Big labs win the time back with kernels and hardware built for routing, and lose some of it to moving tokens between chips, chapter eight's subject.
a1dd1eb444d0.zh: 高兴之前，先提个醒。<bookmark mark='a'/>混合专家模型的计算量和那个小稠密模型一样，但在这台电脑上，它一步训练要花的时间是稠密模型的1.9倍。<bookmark mark='h'/>按专家给词元排序、把它们收集起来、再把答案散回去，这些都要花时间，而计算量的统计看不见它们。<bookmark mark='b'/>大实验室靠专为路由打造的内核和硬件把时间赢回来，又在芯片之间搬运词元上输掉一些，这是第8章的话题。

02ff4c37b3e8.en: Chapter four. Collapse, and Switch's loss.

7ce52d877d19.en: A router learns only from the experts it tries. So what happens to the ones it stops trying? Train our mixture with no help, and watch how the tokens are shared out. <bookmark mark='a'/> Left alone, the router plays favourites. In the worst of three seeds, shown here, the busiest expert ends with 2.5 times its fair share; across the three seeds and both blocks, 2 experts end up with less than a quarter of theirs. <bookmark mark='b'/> It's a rich-get-richer loop: an expert that's chosen more is trained more, gets better, and is chosen even more; a starved expert stops learning, and its parameters are wasted. Shazeer saw it in 2017, and called it a self-reinforcing imbalance.
7ce52d877d19.zh: 路由器只从它试过的专家身上学习。那么，它不再去试的那些专家会怎样？不加任何帮助，训练我们的混合专家模型，看看词元是怎么分配的。<bookmark mark='a'/>放任不管，路由器就会偏心。在3个种子里最差的那个，也就是这里画的，最忙的专家最后拿到公平份额的2.5倍；在3个种子和两个块里，一共有2个专家，最后拿到的不到公平份额的四分之一。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是一个富者愈富的循环：被选中越多的专家，训练得越多，变得越好，又被选得更多；挨饿的专家不再学习，它的参数就浪费了。沙泽尔在2017年就看到了这一点，称之为自我强化的不平衡。

86f64d99b0dc.en: Shazeer's team met this in 2017 and added losses to fight it. <bookmark mark='a'/> The first: add up each expert's gate values over the batch, its importance, and penalize the squared coefficient of variation of those totals, the standard deviation divided by the mean. It's zero only when every expert is equally important. <bookmark mark='b'/> For our unbalanced router, measured on its token shares, the coefficient of variation is 0.33. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pause and think: why divide by the mean? Because then the penalty doesn't care about the overall scale of the gates, only about how unevenly they're spread. A second loss balanced the expected number of tokens, since equal importance can still hide unequal counts.
86f64d99b0dc.zh: 沙泽尔的团队2017年就遇到了这个问题，并加了损失来对付它。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一个：把每个专家在一批数据上的门控值加起来，叫作它的重要性，然后惩罚这些总和的变异系数的平方，变异系数就是标准差除以均值。只有每个专家同样重要的时候，它才是0。<bookmark mark='b'/>对我们那个不均衡的路由器，按它的词元份额来算，变异系数是0.33。<bookmark mark='c'/>停下来想一想：为什么要除以均值？因为这样，惩罚就不在乎门控整体有多大，只在乎它们分布得有多不均匀。第二个损失让期望的词元数也均衡，因为重要性相同，词元数仍然可能不同。

731e7c30a0b6.en: The classic fix adds a penalty to the loss. Two numbers per expert. <bookmark mark='a'/> f i, the share of the batch's token slots actually sent to expert i: a count, so it has no gradient. <bookmark mark='b'/> P i, the router's average probability for expert i: that one is differentiable. <bookmark mark='c'/> The Switch Transformer's penalty is alpha times E times the sum of f i times P i, with alpha a hundredth. <bookmark mark='d'/> Why that product? If the router's probabilities match where tokens go, it's E times the sum of f i squared, which by Cauchy-Schwarz is at least one, with equality only when every expert gets one E-th. <bookmark mark='e'/> And its gradient pushes each expert's probability down in proportion to how busy that expert already is: the favourites get pushed hardest. <bookmark mark='f'/> GShard had used a similar penalty a year earlier, and in 2022 ST-MoE added a second, the z-loss, which keeps the router's scores from growing huge.
731e7c30a0b6.zh: 经典的修正办法，是在损失里加一项惩罚。每个专家有两个数。<bookmark mark='a'/>f i，这一批里真正送到专家i的词元槽份额：这是个计数，所以没有梯度。<bookmark mark='b'/>P i，路由器给专家i的平均概率：这个是可微的。<bookmark mark='c'/>Switch Transformer的惩罚，是α乘以E，再乘以f i乘P i的和，α取百分之一。<bookmark mark='d'/>为什么是这个乘积？如果路由器的概率和词元的实际去向一致，它就是E乘以f i平方的和；由柯西–施瓦茨不等式，它至少是1，当且仅当每个专家都拿到E分之1时取等号。<bookmark mark='e'/>而它的梯度，按每个专家已经有多忙，把它的概率往下压：越受宠的，被压得越狠。<bookmark mark='f'/>GShard早一年就用过类似的惩罚；2022年，ST-MoE又加了第二个，z损失，防止路由器的分数变得太大。

6b8c444e4ea9.en: Here is our mixture again, the same seed, trained with and without the penalty. <bookmark mark='a'/> With Switch's penalty at its usual strength, the busiest expert falls from 1.8 to 1.4 times a fair share, on average over seeds and blocks, and the starved experts from 2 to 0. <bookmark mark='b'/> And the model is better for it: 2.144 bits against 2.152, because experts that work are experts that learn. <bookmark mark='c'/> But the penalty is a second goal, competing with the first. Make alpha too small and the router collapses; make it too big and it bends the routing away from what predicts best. The next chapter removes the trade-off.
6b8c444e4ea9.zh: 还是我们的混合专家模型，同一个种子，加惩罚和不加惩罚各训练一次。<bookmark mark='a'/>用Switch惯用的惩罚强度，最忙的专家从公平份额的1.8倍降到1.4倍，这是对种子和块的平均；挨饿的专家从2个降到0个。<bookmark mark='b'/>模型也因此更好了：2.144比特对2.152，因为干活的专家才会学习。<bookmark mark='c'/>但这个惩罚是第二个目标，和第一个目标相互竞争。α太小，路由器会坍缩；α太大，它会把路由从预测最好的方向上扭开。下一章去掉了这个两难。

5621768a16d6.en: Chapter five. Balancing without a loss.
5621768a16d6.zh: 第5章。不靠损失的负载均衡。

3f48194cafca.en: In 2024 DeepSeek removed the trade-off. Give every expert a bias, a single number, <bookmark mark='a'/> and add it to the expert's score only when choosing the top k. <bookmark mark='b'/> The gates that mix the chosen experts use the scores alone, so the bias changes who works, never what the model computes. <bookmark mark='c'/> After every step, look at the loads: an expert busier than average has its bias lowered by a small step gamma, and an idle one has it raised. There's no extra loss, so no gradient fights the language model. <bookmark mark='d'/> Lean Wang and colleagues reported both better balance and lower perplexity than the auxiliary loss, and DeepSeek-V3 was trained this way.
3f48194cafca.zh: 2024年，DeepSeek去掉了这个两难。给每个专家一个偏置，就一个数，<bookmark mark='a'/>只在挑选前k个的时候，把它加到专家的分数上。<bookmark mark='b'/>混合被选中专家的门控，只用分数本身，所以偏置只改变谁干活，从不改变模型算出的结果。<bookmark mark='c'/>每一步之后，看一看负载：比平均忙的专家，偏置往下调一小步γ；闲着的，往上调。没有额外的损失，也就没有梯度和语言模型作对。<bookmark mark='d'/>王岚和同事们报告说，它比辅助损失均衡得更好，困惑度也更低；DeepSeek-V3就是这样训练的。

2cb0fd3030bf.en: Here is DeepSeek-V3's router exactly, since it's become a template. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each expert gets a score from a sigmoid, its own yes-or-no, rather than a softmax that makes experts compete. <bookmark mark='b'/> The top k are chosen by score plus the balancing bias. <bookmark mark='c'/> The gates use the scores alone, rescaled to add to one. <bookmark mark='d'/> And one shared expert sees every token, to hold what everything needs. <bookmark mark='e'/> The bias moved by a thousandth a step for the first fourteen point three trillion tokens, then froze; a tiny extra loss kept single sequences from piling onto a few experts; and no token was ever dropped.
2cb0fd3030bf.zh: 这是DeepSeek-V3路由器的精确形式，它已经成了一个模板。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个专家的分数来自一个sigmoid，是它自己的“是或否”，而不是让专家们相互竞争的softmax。<bookmark mark='b'/>前k个按分数加均衡偏置来挑。<bookmark mark='c'/>门控只用分数，重新缩放到加起来等于1。<bookmark mark='d'/>还有一个共享专家，每个词元都会经过它，用来存放大家都需要的东西。<bookmark mark='e'/>在前14.3万亿个词元里，偏置每步调千分之一，之后就冻结；一个很小的额外损失，防止单个序列挤到少数几个专家上；而且从没有丢弃过任何词元。

28aa05b571d5.en: Here are all three rules at once, replayed through training: each bar is one expert's share of the tokens in the first block. <bookmark mark='a'/> On the left, with no balancing, the shares drift apart. <bookmark mark='m'/>In the middle, Switch's loss pulls them part of the way back. <bookmark mark='r'/>On the right, the bias holds every expert near its fair share. <bookmark mark='b'/> Below, the biases themselves: each is a running tally of how often its expert was too busy or too idle.
28aa05b571d5.zh: 三种规则同时回放整个训练过程：每根柱子是一个专家在第一个块里拿到的词元份额。<bookmark mark='a'/>左边，不做均衡，份额渐渐拉开。<bookmark mark='m'/>中间，Switch的损失把它们拉回来一部分。<bookmark mark='r'/>右边，偏置让每个专家都保持在公平份额附近。<bookmark mark='b'/>下面是偏置本身：每一个，都是它的专家太忙或太闲的次数的累计。

56c2f986d051.en: The scoreboard, over three seeds each. <bookmark mark='a'/> The bias balances best, with the smallest imbalance through training, 0.21, against 0.47 with the loss and 0.98 without. <bookmark mark='w'/>In held-out bits, though, the best is Switch's loss: 2.144, against 2.146 with the bias. <bookmark mark='b'/> One caution: our bias model also uses DeepSeek's sigmoid gates, while the other two use softmax gates, so the comparison is between routers, not just between balancing rules. <bookmark mark='c'/> The lesson DeepSeek drew: balance by steering the choice, not by changing the loss.
56c2f986d051.zh: 成绩表，每种各3个种子。<bookmark mark='a'/>偏置均衡得最好，训练全程的不平衡度最小，0.21；用损失是0.47，什么都不用是0.98。<bookmark mark='w'/>不过在留出数据的比特数上，最好的是Switch的损失：2.144，偏置是2.146。<bookmark mark='b'/>提醒一句：我们的偏置模型还用了DeepSeek的sigmoid门控，而另外两个用的是softmax门控，所以这是在比较路由器，不只是在比较均衡规则。<bookmark mark='c'/>DeepSeek得出的结论是：靠引导选择来均衡，而不是靠改动损失。

56a500ec3d25.en: Chapter six. Fine-grained and shared experts.
56a500ec3d25.zh: 第6章。细粒度专家与共享专家。

5bd4b5c3cf9e.en: In January 2024 Damai Dai and colleagues at DeepSeek asked how big an expert should be. <bookmark mark='a'/> Mixtral used a few big experts and chose two. <bookmark mark='b'/> Cut every expert into four smaller ones, and choose four times as many: the same parameters, the same arithmetic per token, but each token's mixture is assembled from finer pieces. <bookmark mark='c'/> And set one expert aside to be shared by every token, so that what every token needs, like common words and grammar, is learned once instead of being copied into every expert. They called these fine-grained segmentation and shared-expert isolation.
5bd4b5c3cf9e.zh: 2024年1月，DeepSeek的戴达迈和同事们问：一个专家应该多大？<bookmark mark='a'/>Mixtral用几个大专家，挑2个。<bookmark mark='b'/>把每个专家切成4个小的，挑4倍那么多：参数一样，每个词元的计算量也一样，但每个词元的组合由更细的零件拼成。<bookmark mark='c'/>再留出一个专家，让每个词元共享，这样每个词元都需要的东西，比如常用词和语法，只学一次，而不必复制进每个专家里。他们把这两招叫作细粒度切分和共享专家隔离。

39bf84fbd3d5.en: They reported that it pays. <bookmark mark='a'/> At two billion parameters, DeepSeekMoE matched GShard's design with one and a half times the expert parameters and computation. <bookmark mark='b'/> Scaled to sixteen billion, it matched Meta's dense LLaMA 2 7B with about forty percent of the computation. Those are the makers' own numbers; let's check the idea on ours.
39bf84fbd3d5.zh: 他们报告说这样做划算。<bookmark mark='a'/>在20亿参数的规模上，DeepSeekMoE追平了GShard的设计，而后者的专家参数和计算量是它的1.5倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>扩大到160亿，它追平了Meta的稠密模型LLaMA 2 7B，计算量只用大约40%。这些是作者自己的数字；我们在自己的模型上验证一下这个想法。

ae17286ebfea.en: Why should finer pieces help? Count the teams a token can get. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two of eight experts can be chosen 28 ways. <bookmark mark='b'/> Eight of thirty-two, the same arithmetic, can be chosen 10.5 million ways. <bookmark mark='c'/> The count grows like a power of k: it's squeezed between N over k and e N over k, to the power k. <bookmark mark='d'/> DeepSeek's own example: two of sixteen experts gives 120 teams; cut each into four and choose eight of sixty-four, and there are 4.4 billion. Each token can get a team built more precisely for it.
ae17286ebfea.zh: 为什么更细的零件会有帮助？数一数一个词元能组成多少种团队。<bookmark mark='a'/>8个专家里挑2个，有28种挑法。<bookmark mark='b'/>32个里挑8个，计算量相同，有10.5百万种。<bookmark mark='c'/>这个数像k的幂次一样增长：它被夹在N除以k的k次方，和e乘N除以k的k次方之间。<bookmark mark='d'/>DeepSeek自己的例子：16个专家挑2个，有120种团队；每个切成4份，64个里挑8个，就有4.4十亿种。每个词元都能拿到一支更贴合它的团队。

93c6c2619209.en: We trained all three, with the same parameters and the same arithmetic per character, two seeds each. <bookmark mark='a'/> Cutting the experts finer doesn't help at our scale: 2.156 bits against 2.135 for the coarse mixture. <bookmark mark='v'/>A shared expert adds nothing here: 2.155. <bookmark mark='b'/> At the frontier the direction is clear: DeepSeek-V3 has two hundred and fifty-six fine experts and chooses eight, plus one shared; Kimi K3 has eight hundred and ninety-six, chooses sixteen, and shares two.
93c6c2619209.zh: 我们把三种都训练了，参数相同，每个字符的计算量也相同，各2个种子。<bookmark mark='a'/>在我们的规模上，把专家切细没有帮助：2.156比特，粗粒度的混合是2.135。<bookmark mark='v'/>在这里，共享专家没带来什么：2.155。<bookmark mark='b'/>在前沿，方向很清楚：DeepSeek-V3有256个细粒度专家，挑8个，外加1个共享；Kimi K3有896个，挑16个，共享2个。

e9a9a506b80c.en: Chapter seven. Capacity, and dropped tokens.
e9a9a506b80c.zh: 第7章。容量，与被丢弃的词元。

d37f8a69f44e.en: On real hardware, each expert gets a buffer of fixed size, so that every chip knows its work in advance. <bookmark mark='a'/> The capacity: a factor c times an expert's fair share of the batch, k N over E. <bookmark mark='b'/> When more tokens than that choose one expert, the extra ones are dropped: they skip the layer, carried along by the residual connection, as if the layer weren't there. <bookmark mark='c'/> GShard and Switch trained with factors of one to one and a quarter, and accepted a few dropped tokens. The more uneven the router, the more it drops.
d37f8a69f44e.zh: 在真实的硬件上，每个专家分到一个固定大小的缓冲区，这样每块芯片都能事先知道自己的工作量。<bookmark mark='a'/>容量：一个因子c，乘以专家在这批数据里的公平份额，k N除以E。<bookmark mark='b'/>选中某个专家的词元一旦超过这个数，多出来的就被丢弃：它们跳过这一层，由残差连接带着往前走，就好像这一层不存在。<bookmark mark='c'/>GShard和Switch训练时用的因子是1到1.25，并且接受少量被丢弃的词元。路由器越不均匀，丢得越多。

7674f25e04c6.en: How much is dropped? Expert i is asked for f i times k N slots, its share of all of them. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its buffer holds c times k N over E. <bookmark mark='b'/> Whatever doesn't fit is dropped. <bookmark mark='c'/> Divide by the number of slots, and the dropped share is the sum over experts of how far each one's share exceeds c over E. <bookmark mark='d'/> Pause and predict: with perfectly even routing, what factor drops nothing? One. And if one expert gets twice its share, a factor of one drops exactly the extra: one E-th of all the slots.
7674f25e04c6.zh: 会丢掉多少？专家i被要求的槽位数，是f i乘以k N，也就是它在全部槽位里的份额。<bookmark mark='a'/>它的缓冲区能装c乘以k N除以E。<bookmark mark='b'/>装不下的部分就被丢弃。<bookmark mark='c'/>除以槽位总数，丢弃的份额就是对所有专家求和：每个专家的份额超出c除以E的部分。<bookmark mark='d'/>停下来预测一下：路由完全均匀时，什么因子一个都不丢？1。如果有一个专家拿到两倍份额，因子为1时丢掉的正好是多出来的那部分：全部槽位的E分之1。

797f77f5dcc3.en: We can measure this on our trained routers: impose a capacity afterwards, and count what's dropped. <bookmark mark='a'/> At a factor of one, the unbalanced router drops 22 percent of its token slots, the router trained with Switch's loss 8 percent, and the router with the loss-free bias 2 percent. <bookmark mark='r'/>Even perfect balance on average isn't balance in every batch, so some drops remain. <bookmark mark='b'/> In bits, a factor of one costs the unbalanced model 0.774 bits a character, and the bias model 0.066. <bookmark mark='t'/>Even at a factor of 2, the unbalanced router still loses 0.033.
797f77f5dcc3.zh: 我们可以在训练好的路由器上测一下：事后加上容量限制，数一数丢了多少。<bookmark mark='a'/>因子为1时，不均衡的路由器丢掉22%的词元槽，用Switch损失训练的丢掉8%，用无损失偏置的丢掉2%。<bookmark mark='r'/>平均上完美均衡，不等于每一批都均衡，所以还是会丢掉一些。<bookmark mark='b'/>换成比特，因子为1让不均衡的模型每字符多花0.774比特，偏置模型多花0.066。<bookmark mark='t'/>即使因子为2，不均衡的路由器仍然损失0.033比特。

40d3a914e8e1.en: What if the limit is there during training? <bookmark mark='a'/> Trained with a capacity factor of one from the start, the router learns to fit: drops fall from 24 percent early on to 1.7 percent at the end. <bookmark mark='b'/> The cost: 2.168 bits against 2.135 with no limit. <bookmark mark='c'/> There's another way to avoid drops: let each expert choose its tokens instead, expert choice, from Yanqi Zhou and colleagues in 2022. It balances perfectly by construction, but an expert's choice depends on the whole batch, including tokens that come later, a problem chapter eleven meets again. DeepSeek-V3 drops nothing at all: its balance is good enough, and its kernels flexible enough, to take whatever arrives.
40d3a914e8e1.zh: 如果训练时就有这个限制呢？<bookmark mark='a'/>从一开始就用因子1训练，路由器学会了适应：丢弃率从早期的24%降到最后的1.7%。<bookmark mark='b'/>代价是：2.168比特，不加限制是2.135。<bookmark mark='c'/>还有一种避免丢弃的办法：反过来，让每个专家挑自己的词元，叫作专家选择，是周彦祺和同事们2022年提出的。它天生完全均衡，但一个专家怎么挑，取决于整批数据，包括后面才出现的词元，这个问题第11章还会遇到。DeepSeek-V3一个词元都不丢：它的均衡足够好，内核也足够灵活，来多少收多少。

a3d3f3029d84.zh: 第8章。分布在多块芯片上的专家。

6ee571bf536a.en: A model with hundreds of experts doesn't fit on one chip, so the experts are spread out: expert parallelism, which part 18 builds. Here, eight experts on four GPUs. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each GPU holds some of the tokens, and the router sends them anywhere. <bookmark mark='b'/> So every MoE layer begins with an all-to-all, each GPU sending every token to its experts' GPU, <bookmark mark='c'/> and ends with another, bringing the answers home.
6ee571bf536a.zh: 有几百个专家的模型，一块芯片装不下，所以专家要分散开：这叫专家并行，第18部分会搭建它。这里是8个专家放在4块GPU上。<bookmark mark='a'/>每块GPU上有一部分词元，而路由器可以把它们送到任何地方。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以每个MoE层都以一次全对全通信开始，每块GPU把每个词元送到它的专家所在的GPU，<bookmark mark='c'/>再以另一次全对全通信结束，把答案送回家。

b5f4faef0f8e.en: How expensive is that? Take DeepSeek-V3, one token, one MoE layer. <bookmark mark='a'/> It sends eight copies of a 7,168-number vector out, in eight-bit numbers, and gets eight answers back in sixteen bits: 172 kilobytes. <bookmark mark='b'/> The eight experts do 705 million operations on it. <bookmark mark='c'/> That's 4,096 operations per byte moved: twice the expert's width, whatever the model. <bookmark mark='d'/> But a GPU doing eight-bit arithmetic needs about 39,580 operations per byte from InfiniBand to stay busy, part seventeen's roofline. Sent naively, the network would take 10 times as long as the experts. <bookmark mark='e'/> So DeepSeek sent each token to at most four of its eight machines, crossing InfiniBand once per machine and spreading over NVLink inside it, dispatched in eight bits, and hid the rest by computing one batch while another was in flight.
b5f4faef0f8e.zh: 这有多贵？拿DeepSeek-V3来说，一个词元，一个MoE层。<bookmark mark='a'/>它把一个7168维向量复制8份发出去，用8比特的数，再收回8个答案，用16比特：一共172KB。<bookmark mark='b'/>8个专家在它上面做705百万次运算。<bookmark mark='c'/>也就是每搬一个字节，做4096次运算：等于专家宽度的2倍，不管什么模型都是这样。<bookmark mark='d'/>可一块做8比特运算的GPU，要从InfiniBand每读一个字节就做大约39580次运算，才不会闲着，这是第17部分的屋顶线。直接这样发送的话，网络花的时间是专家计算的10倍。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以DeepSeek让每个词元最多只去8台机器中的4台，每台机器只过一次InfiniBand，到了机器内部再经NVLink分发，发送时用8比特，剩下的开销，靠算一批的同时传另一批来藏起来。

a8b9c1f3cc57.en: And balance, which looked like a matter of using every parameter, turns out to be a matter of speed. Put our trained experts on four GPUs, two each, and count each GPU's share of the work. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every GPU must finish before the next layer can start, so the step takes as long as the busiest GPU. Without balancing, that's 1.36 times a fair share; with Switch's loss, 1.18; with the bias, 1.01. <bookmark mark='b'/> On a real cluster that factor multiplies the time of every MoE layer.
a8b9c1f3cc57.zh: 而均衡，看起来是为了用上每个参数，其实也关乎速度。把我们训练好的专家放到4块GPU上，每块2个，数一数每块GPU分到多少工作。<bookmark mark='a'/>下一层开始之前，每块GPU都得做完，所以一步的时间取决于最忙的那块GPU。不做均衡，它是公平份额的1.36倍；用Switch的损失，1.18倍；用偏置，1.01倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>在真实的集群上，这个倍数会乘到每个MoE层的时间上。

19f175c69f53.en: Chapter nine. Counting parameters, and upcycling.

15ca5046411f.en: What do numbers like six hundred and seventy-one billion parameters, thirty-seven billion active, actually count? We can work them out from DeepSeek-V3's published configuration. <bookmark mark='a'/> One expert is a SwiGLU network: three matrices of 7,168 by 2,048, 44 million parameters. <bookmark mark='b'/> 256 of them in each of 58 MoE layers: 654 billion, nearly everything. <bookmark mark='c'/> Attention, part fifteen's latent attention, adds 11.4 billion across all 61 layers. <bookmark mark='d'/> With the three dense layers, the shared experts, the routers and the embeddings, the total comes to 671.0 billion: the report's 671. <bookmark mark='e'/> A token uses nine experts per layer, eight routed and one shared, plus all the rest: 37.6 billion, the report's thirty-seven.
15ca5046411f.zh: 6710亿个参数、370亿个激活，这样的数字到底数的是什么？我们可以从DeepSeek-V3公开的配置里算出来。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个专家是一个SwiGLU网络：3个7168乘2048的矩阵，44百万个参数。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个MoE层有256个，一共58个MoE层：6540亿，几乎就是全部。<bookmark mark='c'/>注意力，也就是第15部分的潜在注意力，在全部61层里加起来是11.4十亿。<bookmark mark='d'/>再加上3个稠密层、共享专家、路由器和嵌入，总数是671.0十亿：就是报告里的6710亿。<bookmark mark='e'/>一个词元每层用9个专家，8个路由专家加1个共享专家，再加上其余所有部分：37.6十亿，就是报告里的370亿。

b7e4a8568ad2.en: Drawn to scale, DeepSeek-V3's parameters are almost all routed experts. <bookmark mark='a'/> A token uses only 5.6 percent of them. Inside that slice the experts are 61 percent, and attention, which every token uses in full, is 30 percent. <bookmark mark='b'/> The same arithmetic explains Mixtral's name. Eight times seven billion would be fifty-six, but Mixtral 8x7B has 46.7 billion, because only the feed-forward layers are copied eight times; the attention is shared. It uses 12.9 billion per token. <bookmark mark='c'/> And when you see six hundred and eighty-five billion for DeepSeek-V3, that includes a module that predicts a second token ahead, part eighteen's multi-token prediction.
b7e4a8568ad2.zh: 按比例画出来，DeepSeek-V3的参数几乎全是路由专家。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个词元只用其中的5.6%。在这一小片里，专家占61%，而每个词元都完整使用的注意力占30%。<bookmark mark='b'/>同样的算术也解释了Mixtral的名字。8乘70亿应该是560亿，可Mixtral 8x7B只有46.7十亿，因为只有前馈层被复制了8份；注意力是共享的。每个词元它用12.9十亿。<bookmark mark='c'/>当你看到DeepSeek-V3写着6850亿时，那里面包括了一个提前预测第二个词元的模块，也就是第18部分的多词元预测。

d61831766a45.en: Training a big mixture from scratch is expensive. What if you already have a good dense model? <bookmark mark='a'/> Copy its feed-forward layer into every expert, add a new router, and keep training. <bookmark mark='b'/> At the moment of copying, the new model computes exactly what the old one did: every chosen expert gives the same answer, and the gates add to one. Training then pulls the copies apart. <bookmark mark='c'/> Aran Komatsuzaki and colleagues called it sparse upcycling, in 2022; Qwen's first mixture, in 2024, was made this way too.
d61831766a45.zh: 从头训练一个大的混合专家模型很贵。如果你已经有一个好的稠密模型呢？<bookmark mark='a'/>把它的前馈层复制进每个专家，加一个新的路由器，然后接着训练。<bookmark mark='b'/>刚复制完的那一刻，新模型算出的结果和旧模型一模一样：每个被选中的专家给出同样的答案，而门控加起来等于1。接下来的训练，会把这些副本拉开。<bookmark mark='c'/>阿兰·小松崎和同事们2022年把它叫作稀疏升级；2024年，Qwen的第一个混合专家模型也是这样做出来的。

6fe3dae15ecc.en: We tried it. A dense model one expert wide, trained for a thousand steps, then copied into eight experts and trained for a thousand more, beside the same dense model kept dense, and our mixture trained from scratch. <bookmark mark='a'/> The upcycled model drops below the dense one it came from right away, and ends at 2.237 bits against 2.308 for the dense model trained just as long. <bookmark mark='b'/> It doesn't catch the mixture trained from scratch, 2.135, but it spent only 86 percent of its training compute.
6fe3dae15ecc.zh: 我们试了一下。一个只有一个专家宽的稠密模型，训练1000步，然后复制成8个专家，再训练1000步；旁边是同一个一直保持稠密的模型，以及我们从头训练的混合专家模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>升级后的模型马上就低于它的来源稠密模型，最后是2.237比特，而训练同样久的稠密模型是2.308。<bookmark mark='b'/>它没追上从头训练的混合专家模型，2.135，但训练计算量只花了后者的86%。

8c61df8d61b4.en: What do the experts learn? Here's where our mixture sends each common character's tokens, in its last block: one column per character just read, one row per expert. <bookmark mark='a'/> Some patterns appear: 4 of the 5 vowels go mostly to expert 4, and 2 of the 8 spaces and punctuation marks to expert 3. Nobody told it to. <bookmark mark='b'/> But is it about the character itself, or about what comes next? We can measure it.
8c61df8d61b4.zh: 专家们学到了什么？这是我们的混合专家模型在最后一个块里，把每个常见字符的词元送到了哪里：每列是刚读到的一个字符，每行是一个专家。<bookmark mark='a'/>出现了一些规律：5个元音里有4个主要去专家4；8个空格和标点里有2个去专家3。没有人教过它。<bookmark mark='b'/>但这是关于字符本身，还是关于接下来会出现什么？我们可以测一测。

639bb4668616.en: Mutual information, from part one: how many bits the choice of expert tells you about a character. <bookmark mark='a'/> The choice of expert says most about the character just read: 0.77 bits in the last block, against 0.34 about the one to come and 0.37 about the one before. <bookmark mark='v'/>So the experts sort tokens mostly by what they are, on the surface, not by what the model must predict: the router is a fast lookup on the current token. <bookmark mark='b'/> The shuffled bars are chance: what a router that ignored the characters would score, given this much text. <bookmark mark='c'/> With thirty-two smaller experts, the choice says 0.66 bits about the current character, much as with eight.
639bb4668616.zh: 互信息，来自第1部分：选中哪个专家，能告诉你关于一个字符的多少比特。<bookmark mark='a'/>选中哪个专家，最能说明刚读到的那个字符：最后一个块里是0.77比特，对下一个字符是0.34，对前一个字符是0.37。<bookmark mark='v'/>所以专家们主要按词元本身在表面上是什么来分拣它们，而不是按模型要预测什么：路由器是对当前词元的一次快速查表。<bookmark mark='b'/>打乱后的柱子代表偶然：一个不看字符的路由器，在这么多文本上会得到的分数。<bookmark mark='c'/>换成32个更小的专家，选择对当前字符说明了0.66比特，和8个专家时差不多。

b08534813fb6.en: The big models look similar. <bookmark mark='a'/> Mistral's analysis of Mixtral found no experts for topics like biology or philosophy. Instead, syntax: the same expert for the word self in Python, for indentation, and often for consecutive tokens. <bookmark mark='b'/> OLMoE, a fully open mixture from 2024, found clearer specialization, by domain and by vocabulary. <bookmark mark='c'/> The name is a little misleading. An expert isn't a specialist in chemistry; it's a slice of the network that a router learned to reach for, often for reasons on the surface of the text.
b08534813fb6.zh: 大模型看起来也类似。<bookmark mark='a'/>Mistral对Mixtral的分析，没有找到专管生物学或哲学这类主题的专家。反而是语法：Python里的self、缩进，常常由同一个专家处理，相邻的词元也常常去同一个专家。<bookmark mark='b'/>2024年完全开源的混合专家模型OLMoE，发现了更明显的专长，按领域，也按词汇。<bookmark mark='c'/>这个名字有点误导。一个专家并不是化学专家；它是网络里的一小片，路由器学会了去找它，往往出于文本表面上的原因。

a9f4d4881ca4.en: And the scoreboard, the series' running test on a chapter of The Maltese Falcon. <bookmark mark='a'/> On the scoreboard's passage, our mixture scores 2.34 bits a character, ahead of the dense model with the same arithmetic, 2.44, and the dense model with all its parameters scores 2.36. <bookmark mark='w'/>They're behind Part 13's transformer, 2.00, which reads four times as much context and is twice as wide and twice as deep: sparsity buys capacity, not context.
a9f4d4881ca4.zh: 还有记分牌，本系列在《马耳他之鹰》一章上的持续测试。<bookmark mark='a'/>在记分牌的测试段落上，我们的混合专家模型每字符2.34比特，领先于计算量相同的稠密模型，2.44；拥有全部参数的稠密模型是2.36。<bookmark mark='w'/>它们都落后于第13部分的Transformer，2.00；那个模型读4倍长的上下文，宽2倍，深也2倍：稀疏买来的是容量，不是上下文。

81610961ecfc.en: Experts make the width sparse. Can the depth be sparse too? Does every token need every layer? <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2024 David Raposo and colleagues at Google DeepMind gave some blocks a router of their own. It scores every token in the sequence; only the top k go through the block, attention and feed-forward both, and the rest skip it along the residual stream. <bookmark mark='b'/> The block's output is multiplied by the router's score, so the router learns from the loss, as in a mixture of experts. <bookmark mark='c'/> They found it worked best with only an eighth of the tokens in every other block, and sampling from their models was upwards of fifty percent faster.
81610961ecfc.zh: 专家让宽度变得稀疏。深度能不能也稀疏？每个词元都需要每一层吗？<bookmark mark='a'/>2024年，谷歌DeepMind的大卫·拉波索和同事们给一些块配上了自己的路由器。它给序列里的每个词元打分；只有前k个经过这个块，注意力和前馈层都是，其余的沿着残差流跳过它。<bookmark mark='b'/>这个块的输出乘上路由器的分数，所以路由器能从损失中学习，就像混合专家一样。<bookmark mark='c'/>他们发现，每隔一个块、只让八分之一的词元通过，效果最好；从他们的模型采样，快了百分之五十以上。

2308faa87cb1.en: What does it save? In a routed block that takes a fraction c of the T tokens, <bookmark mark='a'/> the matrices act on only c T tokens, <bookmark mark='b'/> and attention, among the chosen tokens only, computes c T squared scores. <bookmark mark='c'/> At an eighth, that's an eighth of the matrix work and a sixty-fourth of the attention. <bookmark mark='d'/> Route every other block of four, and the matrices cost about nine sixteenths of the full model's, per token.
2308faa87cb1.zh: 它省下多少？在一个让T个词元里的c这一部分通过的块里，<bookmark mark='a'/>矩阵只作用在c T个词元上，<bookmark mark='b'/>而注意力只在被选中的词元之间计算，是c T的平方个分数。<bookmark mark='c'/>c取八分之一，矩阵的工作是八分之一，注意力是六十四分之一。<bookmark mark='d'/>4个块里每隔一个做路由，按每个词元算，矩阵的开销大约是完整模型的十六分之九。

abccd98b5024.en: We trained it. Our four-block transformer, with blocks two and four routed, against dense models of two, three and four blocks. Compute per character on one axis, held-out bits on the other. <bookmark mark='a'/> The dense models make a line: more blocks, more compute, fewer bits. <bookmark mark='b'/> At our scale the routed models land on or above the dense line: they save compute, but they don't beat a dense model that spends the same. <bookmark mark='w'/>Against the full four-block model, routing an eighth of the tokens costs 0.082 bits and saves 42 percent of its compute.
abccd98b5024.zh: 我们训练了它。我们的4块Transformer，第2和第4块做路由，对比2块、3块和4块的稠密模型。一个轴是每个字符的计算量，另一个轴是留出数据的比特数。<bookmark mark='a'/>稠密模型连成一条线：块越多，计算越多，比特越少。<bookmark mark='b'/>在我们的规模上，做路由的模型落在稠密模型那条线上或线的上方：它们省了计算，但赢不过花同样计算量的稠密模型。<bookmark mark='w'/>和完整的4块模型相比，只让八分之一的词元通过，多花0.082比特，省下42%的计算。

d1d266d9dbb1.en: Which tokens get the deep treatment? Here's one stretch of held-out text: lit, the characters the routed blocks process. <bookmark mark='a'/> The router favours punctuation: it takes 72 percent of them. <bookmark mark='b'/> But there's a catch. Choosing the top eighth of a sequence means looking at the whole sequence, later tokens included, which a model writing one token at a time can't do. The paper trains the router to predict its own top-k choice, with an extra loss, so that at generation it can decide alone. <bookmark mark='c'/> Deciding alone, the router sends 13 percent of the tokens through, close to the eighth it was trained for, and the bits barely move, 2.248 against 2.250.
d1d266d9dbb1.zh: 哪些词元得到了深度处理？这是留出文本中的一段：亮起来的，是做路由的块处理的字符。<bookmark mark='a'/>路由器偏爱标点：其中72%都被它选中。<bookmark mark='b'/>但有个问题。挑出一个序列的前八分之一，就得看整个序列，包括后面的词元，而一次写一个词元的模型做不到这一点。论文用一个额外的损失，训练路由器去预测它自己的top-k选择，这样生成的时候它就能独自决定。<bookmark mark='c'/>独自决定时，路由器让13%的词元通过，接近它训练时的八分之一，比特数几乎没变，2.248对2.250。

ef6078cc77c7.en: Chapter twelve. How sparse is attention?

299f25384ac0.en: Attention reads every earlier token, so its cost grows with the square of the length. <bookmark mark='a'/> The first answers fixed the pattern in advance. OpenAI's Sparse Transformer, in 2019, read a local window and every k-th key, for a cost that grows like the length to the power one and a half. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2020, Longformer added a few global keys that everyone reads, and Google's BigBird added random ones as well, and proved that such patterns lose no expressive power in principle. <bookmark mark='c'/> Mistral 7B, in 2023, kept just a sliding window, and stacked layers let information travel further back. Part 19 measures what windows save at serving time. <bookmark mark='d'/> But all of these decide in advance which keys a query may read. Does that match where attention actually goes?
299f25384ac0.zh: 注意力要读之前的每一个词元，所以它的开销随长度的平方增长。<bookmark mark='a'/>最早的办法，是事先把模式定死。2019年OpenAI的稀疏Transformer，读一个局部窗口，再加每隔k个的一个键，开销按长度的1.5次方增长。<bookmark mark='b'/>2020年，Longformer加了几个人人都读的全局键，谷歌的BigBird又加上随机的键，并证明这样的模式在原理上不损失表达能力。<bookmark mark='c'/>2023年的Mistral 7B只保留一个滑动窗口，靠层层叠加让信息传得更远。第19部分会测量窗口在服务时省下多少。<bookmark mark='d'/>但这些都是事先决定一个查询可以读哪些键。这和注意力实际去的地方相符吗？

6b5bb77ab3db.en: Attention looks at every earlier token, but how much of that does it use? Take part thirteen's transformer and, for each query, rank its keys by weight. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each line is one head: how much of the attention its top k keys hold. On average, the top sixteen keys, out of between a hundred and twenty-eight and two hundred and fifty-six, hold 92 percent. Most of the attention goes to a few keys.
6b5bb77ab3db.zh: 注意力会看之前的每个词元，可它真正用到了多少？拿第13部分的Transformer来说，对每个查询，把它的键按权重排序。<bookmark mark='a'/>每条线是一个头：前k个键占了多少注意力。平均来说，在128到256个键里，前16个键占了92%。大部分注意力都落在少数几个键上。

f14a53388f7d.en: Pause and predict. If each query may keep only eight keys, which choice loses less: the eight most recent, or the eight the query itself scores highest? <bookmark mark='a'/> The window is cheap to compute: it's fixed in advance. Choosing by score needs the scores first.
f14a53388f7d.zh: 停下来预测一下。如果每个查询只能保留8个键，哪种选法损失更小：最近的8个，还是查询自己打分最高的8个？<bookmark mark='a'/>窗口算起来便宜：它是事先定好的。按分数挑，得先有分数。

996c79383584.en: So let each query use only k keys. Which k? <bookmark mark='a'/> The simplest choice is the most recent ones, a sliding window: with 8 keys, 1.85 bits a character. <bookmark mark='b'/> Better, take the 8 keys it would weight most: 1.80. <bookmark mark='c'/>With 64 keys chosen by score, it's within a thousandth of a bit of using every key.
996c79383584.zh: 那就让每个查询只用k个键。哪k个？<bookmark mark='a'/>最简单的是最近的几个，也就是滑动窗口：用8个键，每字符1.85比特。<bookmark mark='b'/>更好的办法，是取它权重最高的8个键：1.80。<bookmark mark='c'/>按分数挑64个键，和用全部键的差距不到千分之一比特。

9f1938228764.en: Chapter thirteen. Sparse attention, by design.
9f1938228764.zh: 第13章。设计出来的稀疏注意力。

6b0c8758e652.en: Choosing by score is what real models now do. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here's one query in our transformer, and how it weighs its last forty-eight keys. Together they hold 90 percent of its attention, and most of it lands on a handful of characters well back from the end. <bookmark mark='b'/> A sliding window keeps only the last eight keys: they hold just 7 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> DeepSeek's native sparse attention cuts the past into blocks and squeezes each one into a summary. <bookmark mark='d'/> The query scores the summaries, reads the best blocks in full, and keeps a window of recent tokens too: 75 percent, from 16 keys. <bookmark mark='e'/> In DeepSeek-V3.2, a tiny, fast indexer gives every past token a score, and the query attends to the top ones only: two thousand and forty-eight in the real model, eight here, holding 76 percent. <bookmark mark='f'/> The trick in both is that finding the important keys must be much cheaper than attending to all of them.
6b0c8758e652.zh: 按分数挑，正是现在的真实模型在做的。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是我们Transformer里的一个查询，以及它怎样给最后48个键分配权重。这些键加起来占了它90%的注意力，而大部分落在离末尾很远的几个字符上。<bookmark mark='b'/>滑动窗口只保留最后8个键：它们只占7%。<bookmark mark='c'/>DeepSeek的原生稀疏注意力，把过去切成块，再把每一块压缩成一个摘要。<bookmark mark='d'/>查询给这些摘要打分，把最好的几块完整读一遍，再保留一个最近词元的窗口：75%，用了16个键。<bookmark mark='e'/>在DeepSeek-V3.2里，一个又小又快的索引器给过去的每个词元打分，查询只关注得分最高的那些：真实模型里是2048个，这里是8个，占了76%。<bookmark mark='f'/>两者的诀窍都在于：找出重要的键，必须比关注全部键便宜得多。

1519e1d34070.en: In equations: <bookmark mark='a'/> NSA's output is a gated sum of three attentions, over the block summaries, over the chosen blocks in full, and over a recent window, with gates the model learns. <bookmark mark='b'/> DSA's indexer scores each past token with a few small heads: a weighted sum of rectified dot products, where any negative score is set to zero, part nine's ReLU, all computed in eight-bit numbers: each rounded to one of two hundred and fifty-six values, to save time and memory. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then real attention runs over the top two thousand and forty-eight. <bookmark mark='d'/> The indexer still looks at every pair, but it's so small that the expensive part now grows with the length times two thousand, not the length squared.
1519e1d34070.zh: 写成公式：<bookmark mark='a'/>NSA的输出是三个注意力的门控加权和：对块的摘要、对选中块的完整内容、对最近的窗口，门控由模型学出来。<bookmark mark='b'/>DSA的索引器用几个小头给过去的每个词元打分：是一组被整流的点积的加权和，负的分数全部置为0，也就是第9部分的ReLU，全部用8比特数计算：每个数都取整到256个值之一，以节省时间和内存。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后真正的注意力只在前2048个上运行。<bookmark mark='d'/>索引器仍然要看每一对，但它非常小，所以昂贵的部分现在随长度乘以2048增长，而不是随长度的平方增长。

6d37abca8959.en: Can a model learn where to look? We need a task where it matters. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each sequence starts with eight facts, each a single token that binds a key to a value: key three goes with value eleven, say. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then forty tokens of filler. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then each key is asked, and the model must answer with its value. The fact it needs is at least forty tokens back. <bookmark mark='d'/> We train our small transformer on it with full attention, and with three sparse patterns that each allow 8 keys per query: a sliding window; block selection, the query's own block of four and the one block whose average key it scores best, as in MoBA and NSA; and a learned indexer that may pick any keys, as in DeepSeek's sparse attention.
6d37abca8959.zh: 模型能学会看哪里吗？我们需要一个看哪里很要紧的任务。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个序列开头有8条事实，每条是一个词元，把一个键和一个值绑在一起：比如键3对应值11。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后是40个填充词元。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后逐个问这些键，模型必须答出对应的值。它需要的那条事实，至少在40个词元之前。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们用全注意力训练小Transformer，再用三种稀疏模式训练，每种都允许每个查询用8个键：滑动窗口；块选择，也就是查询自己那一块4个，加上平均键得分最高的那一块，就像MoBA和NSA；以及一个可以挑任意键的学出来的索引器，就像DeepSeek的稀疏注意力。

c5b2c68914aa.en: Here's training, the share of answers right. <bookmark mark='a'/> Full attention learns it completely: 100 percent. The sliding window can't see the facts, and stays near chance, 7 percent. <bookmark mark='b'/> Block selection gets 84 percent: it learns to find the right block. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the learned indexer, started from the full model, reaches 100 percent with eight keys. <bookmark mark='d'/> Imposing a pattern on the full model without retraining is a different story: its own top eight keys keep 100 percent, so the information is there, if you can find it cheaply.
c5b2c68914aa.zh: 这是训练过程，答对的比例。<bookmark mark='a'/>全注意力完全学会了：100%。滑动窗口看不到那些事实，一直停在偶然水平附近，7%。<bookmark mark='b'/>块选择达到84%：它学会了找到正确的块。<bookmark mark='c'/>而从全注意力模型出发、学出来的索引器，只用8个键就达到了100%。<bookmark mark='d'/>不重新训练，直接给全注意力模型套上一种模式，就是另一回事了：它自己得分最高的8个键保留了100%，所以信息都在，只要能便宜地找到它。

dd7a118c1aa1.en: This year's frontier combines the ideas. <bookmark mark='a'/> DeepSeek-V4, released in April 2026, compresses every 4 keys and values into one entry, and a lightning indexer chooses the best 1,024 of those for each query, with a window of the last 128 tokens for local detail. <bookmark mark='b'/> Other layers compress 128 to one and read everything that's left. <bookmark mark='c'/> Its indexer has 64 heads, computed in 4-bit numbers. <bookmark mark='d'/> At a million tokens, DeepSeek reports 27 percent of V3.2's computation per token and 10 percent of its cache. What the cache saves is part fifteen's subject, and serving it is part nineteen's.
dd7a118c1aa1.zh: 今年的前沿把这些想法结合了起来。<bookmark mark='a'/>2026年4月发布的DeepSeek-V4，把每4个键和值压缩成一个条目，再由一个闪电索引器为每个查询挑出最好的1024个，外加最后128个词元的窗口，负责局部细节。<bookmark mark='b'/>另一些层把128个压成1个，剩下的全部读一遍。<bookmark mark='c'/>它的索引器有64个头，用4比特的数计算。<bookmark mark='d'/>在一百万个词元时，DeepSeek报告说，每个词元的计算量是V3.2的27%，缓存是10%。缓存省下了什么，是第15部分的话题；怎样提供服务，是第19部分的。

8d8ec7628246.en: The third kind of sparsity is the oldest: removing weights. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1990 Yann LeCun, John Denker and Sara Solla removed the weights whose loss the Hessian said would hurt least, and called it optimal brain damage. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2015 Song Han and colleagues showed how much can go: prune the smallest weights, retrain, repeat, and AlexNet shrank 9 times, VGG 13 times, with no loss in accuracy. <bookmark mark='c'/> But a strange thing was known: the small pruned network, trained from scratch, did worse. In 2018 Jonathan Frankle and Michael Carbin found that it trains well only from its original starting weights. <bookmark mark='d'/> Their conjecture: a big random network contains a small subnetwork, a winning lottery ticket, that could have been trained alone to the same accuracy. The big network is how you buy enough tickets.
8d8ec7628246.zh: 第三种稀疏最古老：去掉权重。<bookmark mark='a'/>1990年，扬·勒丘恩、约翰·登克和萨拉·索拉，按海森矩阵的估计，去掉对损失伤害最小的权重，称之为最优脑损伤。<bookmark mark='b'/>2015年，韩松和同事们展示了能去掉多少：剪掉最小的权重，再训练，重复，AlexNet缩小了9倍，VGG缩小了13倍，准确率不变。<bookmark mark='c'/>但有件怪事早就为人所知：剪出来的小网络，从头训练，效果反而更差。2018年，乔纳森·弗兰克尔和迈克尔·卡宾发现，它只有从原来的初始权重出发才训练得好。<bookmark mark='d'/>他们的猜想：一个随机的大网络里，藏着一个小的子网络，一张中奖彩票，单独训练也能达到同样的准确率。大网络，只是你买够彩票的方式。

ce796fa3ff43.en: How do you find a ticket? Train, prune, rewind, repeat. <bookmark mark='a'/> Train the network; remove the 20 percent of weights smallest in size; rewind the survivors to the values they had early in training, here at step 50; and train again. Rewinding to a few steps in, rather than to the very start, was Frankle's later fix for bigger networks. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our network reads three characters and guesses the next. Here is a corner of its weights, round by round, as the mask thins to 22 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> The tests: the same mask with fresh random weights, and a random mask of the same size.
ce796fa3ff43.zh: 怎样找到一张彩票？训练、剪枝、回卷、重复。<bookmark mark='a'/>训练网络；去掉幅度最小的20%的权重；把幸存的权重回卷到训练早期的值，这里是第50步；然后再训练。回卷到训练开始后几步，而不是最开头，是弗兰克尔后来为更大的网络找到的修正。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的网络读3个字符，猜下一个。这是它权重的一角，一轮一轮地，看掩码怎样变稀，直到只剩22%。<bookmark mark='c'/>对照组：同样的掩码配新的随机权重，以及同样大小的随机掩码。

c48a9f1b665a.en: Here are the three, round by round, as the network thins. <bookmark mark='a'/> The ticket stays as good as the dense network down to 27 percent of its weights, and at some sizes it's even a little better. <bookmark mark='b'/> With the same masks but fresh random weights, the network does worse, by 0.22 bits at the sparsest: the starting weights matter, not just which connections are kept. <bookmark mark='c'/> Random masks of the same size do worst of all, 3.16 bits at the sparsest. <bookmark mark='d'/> The catch: finding the smallest ticket took 9 full trainings. Lottery tickets changed how people think about why big networks train well. To save compute in practice, sparsity has to be found cheaply, and has to suit the hardware: the next chapter.
c48a9f1b665a.zh: 这是三者一轮轮的结果，随着网络变得越来越稀。<bookmark mark='a'/>一直到只剩27%的权重，彩票都和稠密网络一样好，在某些大小上甚至还好一点。<bookmark mark='b'/>同样的掩码配上新的随机权重，网络就更差，在最稀的时候差0.22比特：初始权重很重要，不只是保留了哪些连接。<bookmark mark='c'/>同样大小的随机掩码最差，在最稀的时候是3.16比特。<bookmark mark='d'/>问题在于：找到最小的那张彩票，用了9次完整的训练。彩票假设改变了人们对大网络为什么好训练的看法。要在实践中节省计算，稀疏必须能便宜地找到，还得适合硬件：这是下一章的内容。

7ab28cd44db9.en: Chapter fifteen. Two in four, and sparse activations.
7ab28cd44db9.zh: 第15章。四选二，以及稀疏的激活。

de357cd5eea6.en: Removing half the weights doesn't make a network twice as fast. The zeros are scattered, and a GPU reads and multiplies in dense blocks. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here's a corner of our dense model's first feed-forward matrix. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2020 NVIDIA's A100 introduced a compromise: two in four. In every group of four consecutive weights, exactly two must be zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then the matrix can be stored as two values and two small position indices per group, and the sparse tensor cores of part seventeen multiply it at twice the dense rate.
de357cd5eea6.zh: 去掉一半权重，并不会让网络快一倍。零是零散分布的，而GPU是按稠密的块来读、来乘的。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是我们稠密模型第一个前馈矩阵的一角。<bookmark mark='b'/>2020年，英伟达的A100引入了一个折中：四选二。每4个相邻的权重里，正好有2个必须是0。<bookmark mark='c'/>这样，矩阵每组只需存2个值和2个小的位置索引，第17部分的稀疏张量核心就能以稠密速度的2倍来乘它。

48e4f182361a.en: What does two in four cost? We pruned every weight matrix of our dense model, three seeds. <bookmark mark='a'/> Pruning half the weights hurts: by size and in any pattern, 0.68 bits a character; forced into two in four, 1.20; at random, 2.9. <bookmark mark='b'/> Wanda's score, which weighs each weight by the size of the inputs it multiplies, does better: 0.94. <bookmark mark='c'/> A short retraining with the pattern held closes most of the gap: 0.10 bits behind the dense model after 300 steps. That's NVIDIA's recipe: prune once, then retrain. For big language models, SparseGPT in 2023 pruned without retraining, using part nineteen's GPTQ machinery.
48e4f182361a.zh: 四选二要付出什么代价？我们把稠密模型的每个权重矩阵都剪了，3个种子。<bookmark mark='a'/>剪掉一半权重是有代价的：按幅度、任意模式，每字符多0.68比特；强制成四选二，多1.20；随机剪，多2.9。<bookmark mark='b'/>Wanda的分数，把每个权重按它所乘输入的大小加权，效果更好：多0.94。<bookmark mark='c'/>保持模式不变、短暂地再训练一下，就补回了大部分差距：300步之后，只比稠密模型多0.10比特。这就是英伟达的做法：剪一次，再训练。对大语言模型，2023年的SparseGPT不用再训练就能剪枝，用的是第19部分GPTQ那一套方法。

2a62199a1997.en: Sparsity also hides in the activations. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here are our dense model's feed-forward activations, after the GELU: 39 percent of them are smaller than a tenth. A neuron whose activation is zero needn't be computed, nor its weights read. <bookmark mark='b'/> So set the smallest ones to zero and see what it costs. Zeroing half of them costs 0.064 bits a character; zeroing ninety percent costs 0.47.
2a62199a1997.zh: 稀疏也藏在激活里。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是我们稠密模型前馈层经过GELU之后的激活：其中39%小于十分之一。激活为0的神经元，既不用计算，它的权重也不用读。<bookmark mark='b'/>那就把最小的那些置为0，看看代价是多少。置零一半，每字符多0.064比特；置零百分之九十，多0.47。

27d8a6d1e3a0.en: With ReLU the zeros are exact. In the small ReLU network of the lottery chapter, 36 percent of hidden units are exactly zero for a given input by the end of training. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2022 Zonglin Li and colleagues found that only three percent of T5-Base's activations are nonzero, and called it the lazy neuron phenomenon. <bookmark mark='b'/> Modern models use GELU and SwiGLU, without exact zeros, but in 2024 TEAL zeroed the smallest forty to fifty percent of Llama's activations, with little loss, and decoded up to 1.8 times faster, because a zero means a column of weights that needn't be read. <bookmark mark='c'/> The common thread of this part: sparsity pays when the hardware can skip it.
27d8a6d1e3a0.zh: 用ReLU的话，零是精确的。在彩票那一章的小ReLU网络里，训练结束时，对一个给定的输入，36%的隐藏单元正好是0。<bookmark mark='a'/>2022年，李宗霖和同事们发现，T5-Base只有百分之三的激活不为零，称之为懒惰神经元现象。<bookmark mark='b'/>现代模型用GELU和SwiGLU，没有精确的零；但2024年TEAL把Llama最小的百分之四十到五十的激活置零，损失很小，解码最多快了1.8倍，因为一个零，意味着一列权重不用读。<bookmark mark='c'/>这一部分的共同线索：只有硬件能跳过的稀疏，才划算。

f531896e5e8a.en: Where has all this led? Here are the large open mixtures of the last three years, by how many experts each layer holds. <bookmark mark='a'/> In December 2023 Mixtral had eight. A year later DeepSeek-V3 had two hundred and fifty-six, plus a shared one. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2025 the field followed: Qwen3, Kimi K2 with three hundred and eighty-four, GLM-4.5, OpenAI's gpt-oss, MiniMax, and Qwen3-Next with five hundred and twelve. <bookmark mark='c'/> And in 2026, GLM-5, Qwen3.5, DeepSeek-V4, Mistral Large 4 released this week, and Kimi K3, with 896 experts in a layer and 16 chosen. Almost all of them are fine-grained, and most keep a shared expert.
f531896e5e8a.zh: 这一切最终走到了哪里？这里是过去三年里那些大型的开源混合专家模型，按照每一层里有多少个专家，从左到右排开。<bookmark mark='a'/>2023年12月，米斯特拉尔的模型每层只有8个专家。一年以后，深度求索的第三代模型就有了256个，另外还有一个共享专家。<bookmark mark='b'/>到了2025年，各家纷纷跟进：通义千问第三代，月之暗面有384个专家的模型，智谱的模型，OpenAI的开源模型，稀宇科技的模型，还有通义千问那个每层512个专家的新模型。<bookmark mark='c'/>而在2026年，有智谱的第五代、通义千问的新一代、深度求索的第四代、米斯特拉尔这周刚刚发布的大模型，以及月之暗面的K3：每层896个专家，每次挑选16个。它们几乎全都是细粒度的，而且大多数还保留了共享专家。

9f7d2e5bc3fd.en: And by the share of the model each token uses. <bookmark mark='a'/> Mixtral used 28 percent of its weights per token; DeepSeek-V3, 5.5. <bookmark mark='b'/> The newest use three to five percent: DeepSeek-V4-Pro 3.1, Kimi K3 3.7, and the sparsest here, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, 3.1. A trillion-parameter model that costs per token what a thirty- to fifty-billion dense model costs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Mixtures are also in the closed models: Google's Gemini 1.5 and 2.5 reports describe sparse mixtures of experts, and OpenAI's open gpt-oss is one, though most labs don't publish their architecture.
9f7d2e5bc3fd.zh: 再看每个词元用到模型的多大比例。<bookmark mark='a'/>Mixtral每个词元用28%的权重；DeepSeek-V3是5.5%。<bookmark mark='b'/>最新的只用3%到5%：DeepSeek-V4-Pro 3.1%，Kimi K3 3.7%，这里最稀疏的DeepSeek-V4-Pro，3.1%。一个万亿参数的模型，每个词元的成本只相当于一个三百亿到五百亿参数的稠密模型。<bookmark mark='c'/>闭源模型里也有混合专家：谷歌Gemini 1.5和2.5的报告都写明是稀疏混合专家，OpenAI开源的gpt-oss也是，不过大多数实验室不公开它们的架构。

6880ff523e15.en: And attention. <bookmark mark='a'/> In February 2025, DeepSeek's native sparse attention and Moonshot's MoBA both chose blocks of the past, and MoBA was already serving Kimi's long requests. <bookmark mark='b'/> In September, DeepSeek-V3.2's indexer chose single tokens. <bookmark mark='c'/> Not everyone was convinced: MiniMax went back to full attention for M2, saying its efficient hybrids matched full attention on the usual benchmarks but fell short on multi-step reasoning. <bookmark mark='d'/> But in 2026 GLM-5 adopted DeepSeek's sparse attention, DeepSeek-V4 compressed before choosing, MiniMax came back to sparse attention for M3, and Kimi K3 went mostly linear, part fifteen's subject. <bookmark mark='e'/> The 2026 recipe, then: many fine experts, a shared one, balancing that steers instead of penalizing, and attention that compresses, then chooses.
6880ff523e15.zh: 再看注意力。<bookmark mark='a'/>2025年2月，DeepSeek的原生稀疏注意力和月之暗面的MoBA，都选择过去内容的块，而MoBA已经在为Kimi的长文本请求服务。<bookmark mark='b'/>9月，DeepSeek-V3.2的索引器开始挑单个的词元。<bookmark mark='c'/>并非人人都信服：MiniMax的M2回到了全注意力，说他们的高效混合方案在常规基准上和全注意力不相上下，但在多步推理上有欠缺。<bookmark mark='d'/>但到了2026年，GLM-5采用了DeepSeek的稀疏注意力，DeepSeek-V4先压缩再挑选，MiniMax在M3上又回到了稀疏注意力，而Kimi K3主要用线性注意力，那是第15部分的话题。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以2026年的配方是：许多细粒度专家，一个共享专家，靠引导而不是靠惩罚来均衡，以及先压缩、再挑选的注意力。

16d512c9c0a4.en: Let's take stock. In 1991 experts learned to compete and specialize. A router learns only from the experts it tries, which is why it needs noise to explore and help to share. Our own mixture beat a dense model with the same arithmetic. <bookmark mark='o'/>Left alone, routers play favourites; Switch's loss and DeepSeek's bias spread the work, and the bias does it without bending the model. Finer experts, a shared one, capacity and chips, all follow from the same picture. Attention can choose its keys too, if the choice is learned. And weights can be pruned: lottery tickets exist, and two-in-four is the pattern hardware can use.
16d512c9c0a4.zh: 我们来盘点一下。1991年，专家们学会了竞争和专精。路由器只从它试过的专家身上学习，所以需要噪声来探索，需要帮助来分担。我们自己的混合专家模型，胜过了计算量相同的稠密模型。<bookmark mark='o'/>放任不管，路由器会偏心；Switch的损失和DeepSeek的偏置让工作分散开，而偏置做到这一点，不会扭曲模型。更细的专家、共享专家、容量和芯片，都出自同一幅图景。注意力也能挑自己的键，只要这个选择是学出来的。权重也可以剪：中奖彩票确实存在，而四选二是硬件能用上的模式。

8a5deed356fc.en: All of this comes back. The tensor cores and links that make experts and two-in-four fast are next time's subject, part seventeen. Part eighteen trains across thousands of chips, with expert parallelism and its all-to-all. Part nineteen serves experts and sparse attention. Image and video models use experts too, in part twenty-two. And in part thirty, sparsity shows up inside the network itself: features that fire only rarely, found with sparse autoencoders.
8a5deed356fc.zh: 这些都会再出现。让专家和四选二变快的张量核心和互连，是下一次，第17部分的话题。第18部分在成千上万块芯片上训练，用到专家并行和它的全对全通信。第19部分为专家和稀疏注意力提供服务。图像和视频模型也用专家，在第22部分。而在第30部分，稀疏出现在网络内部：只偶尔激活的特征，用稀疏自编码器找出来。

341c84f37b8c.en: Here are six problems to try, from the router's gradient to counting Mixtral's parameters. Pause here, and work through them; full solutions are in this part's notes.
341c84f37b8c.zh: 这里有6道习题，从路由器的梯度到数Mixtral的参数。在这里暂停，动手做一做；完整的解答在本部分的笔记里。

2c770c89e1ec.en: Next time: silicon. Why does all of this run on GPUs, and what limits it: arithmetic, memory, and the wires between chips. <bookmark mark='a'/> Part seventeen.
2c770c89e1ec.zh: 下一次：硅。为什么这一切都跑在GPU上，又被什么限制：运算、内存，以及芯片之间的连线。<bookmark mark='a'/>第17部分。

d8d6c045c7a7.en: To go further, the Switch Transformer and DeepSeek-V3 papers are good places to start. Thanks for watching, and see you in part seventeen.
d8d6c045c7a7.zh: 如果想再深入一些，可以从谷歌的Switch论文和深度求索第三代模型的技术报告读起，它们都是很好的起点。谢谢观看，我们第17部分再见。
